verdict.rationale: The only mobile-relevant evidence is the Sync doc, which says graphs sync between Logseq Desktop, Android, and iOS. That confirms native mobile apps exist and can hold the whole graph. The capture, search, and linking docs (references, queries, quick capture) are written generically and never confirm these features work on mobile. missing for 10: evidence of mobile feature parity for capture, search, and linking; mobile-specific docs; hands-on or independent reports of the iOS/Android apps being full-featured rather than companion apps.
